title: StreamDrop
subtitle: YouTube Downloader for Android
description: A high-performance, on-device Android application for downloading YouTube videos and audio. Engineered with a modern MVVM architecture using Jetpack Compose, it leverages yt-dlp and FFmpeg to process media securely without external servers. Features include intelligent background downloading via WorkManager, direct MP3 extraction, and a dynamic Material 3 interface.

title: AI Talkie (VoiceAI)
subtitle: Continuous-Conversation Voice Assistant
description: An always-listening, continuous-conversation AI voice assistant for Android inspired by TARS from Interstellar. Built natively with Kotlin, it integrates Android's SpeechRecognizer and TextToSpeech APIs with the Groq API (Llama 3) for near-instant, natural responses. Engineered with a lightweight OkHttp networking stack to ensure high performance on lower-end devices, featuring graceful error recovery and short-term conversation memory.

title: College Canteen Food Ordering System
subtitle: Smart Canteen Order Management
description: A comprehensive smart canteen order management system built for college campuses. It allows students to browse the daily menu, order food, and pay securely via Razorpay from their phones. The platform features an admin dashboard for live order tracking, menu inventory management, and QR code verification. Includes automated daily menu scheduling and cleanup routines. Co-developed with Keerthana V Saji and Keerthana S.

title: Arduino Smart Home Automation
subtitle: Hardware & IoT Prototypes
description: Designed and built automated hardware prototypes using Arduino microcontrollers. Key projects include a smart weather-responsive clothesline that automatically retracts garments into the shade upon detecting raindrops, and an integrated home fire alarm system. These prototypes demonstrate practical applications of sensor integration and automated control systems.

title: Custom Electronics & Hardware Builds
subtitle: Circuitry & Power Systems
description: A collection of custom-built electronic circuits and hardware projects driven by personal passion. Highlights include designing and assembling a functional power inverter from scratch for a college exhibition—utilizing transformers, MOSFETs, and resistors to convert DC to AC power—alongside various other analog circuitry explorations.
